register: Ibn Rajab, Taqrīr al-Qawāʿid: apparent contradictions inside his book and across the bank, resolved by the bank
method: As in sadi.json: two qawāʿid, each read without its qayd, rule opposite ways on a shared case, and the pair is resolved by Usul.resolve and al-Saʿdī's rules of reading (Q29, Q57). The qayd is always Ibn Rajab's own sentence in the pinned witness. A rule of another work in the bank is named work:number.

pairs.case_en: An act done on a belief later shown wrong: Q66 (as read) upholds it only where a valid basis exists in fact; Q6 upholds it unless another's right attaches or he was negligent. With no valid basis, Q66 voids what Q6 upholds; with another's right attached, Q6 undoes what Q66 upholds.
pairs.qayd_en: Q66 speaks only where the true basis exists; elsewhere Q6.

author.excerpt_ar: ثم تبين خطؤه فيه وأن السبب المعتمد غيره وهو موجود

pairs.case_en: The original found while performing the substitute: al-Saʿdī's Q28 allows the substitute only when the original is impossible, so he switches; Ibn Rajab's Q7 lets one who began a general concession continue.
pairs.qayd_en: Q28 governs the substitute instituted from necessity; the general concession stands (Q7's first type).

author.excerpt_ar: الضرب الثاني: أن يكون المتلبس به إنما شرع ضرورة للعجز عن الأصل وتعذره
فهذا يلزمه الانتقال إلى الأصل عند القدرة عليه
